title: Angry Birds Classic
notes: POCO X3 ARM64 test on 2026-11-02. Exact IPA SHA-256 3780905c2746f91311450f24829c7cdcd44d2af011d9815465d1c85ed131416a. Identical Loading frames at 120, 180 and 240 seconds advanced to the Play menu by 300 seconds in a Debug build. Play -> Poached Eggs -> level 1 reached live slingshot gameplay. Two touch drags launched birds and moved the camera; Pause and Resume returned to the same level. Score remained zero, so a hit, level clear and full playability are not claimed. Acoustic audio, native saves and sustained play were not checked.

testedOn.device: POCO X3 NFC (M2007J20CG), Android 12, ARM64, Adreno 618
